description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'DateMismatchException' used in the loan account module of the Fineract project. It extends a platform domain rule exception and is thrown when the actual disbursement date does not match the expected disbursement date.

classes.name: DateMismatchException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating a mismatch between actual and expected disbursement dates in a loan account context.

methods.name: DateMismatchException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with actual and expected disbursement dates, constructing an appropriate error message.
